# Kosh

> Kosh is the financial decision layer for Bangladesh — a platform where people learn, compare, practice with paper money, and confidently decide what to do with their money, guided by an AI coach that knows local products (Sanchaypatra, DPS, FDR, mutual funds, DSE stocks, gold).

Official website: https://www.koshbd.com/
App (beta): https://app.koshbd.com/
Contact: koshinitiative@gmail.com
Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh — expanding toward Bangladeshi diaspora corridors (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Malaysia, UK, Canada) and other emerging markets.
Languages: English and Bengali. "Kosh" (কোষ) is Bengali for treasury.

## What Kosh Does

- The core loop: Check (money level diagnostic) → Ask (AI coach) → Learn (short lessons built for Bangladesh) → Practice (paper trading with play money) → Act (clear real-world steps with disclosed partners).
- AI coach that answers with Bangladeshi products and context, adapted to the user's level and goals.
- Decision helper: guided flows for questions like "where should this ৳20,000 go?"
- Paper trading: practice portfolios in taka — gold, mutual funds, Sanchaypatra, DSE stocks — with zero risk.
- Mutual fund screener with side-by-side comparison and a halal filter.
- Calculators: SIP, EMI, savings, budgeting.
- Gamified learning zones with XP.
- Honesty principles: no fabricated returns (missing data shows as "—"), partner relationships disclosed, risky assets like crypto and CFDs taught rather than sold.
- Programs: financial literacy workshops for universities, workplaces, and communities; campus ambassadors; research collaborations.
- Kosh provides financial education and decision support, not personalized investment advice.

## Audience

- First-time money decision-makers: students, first-salary professionals, young families, freelancers, women building financial independence.
- The Bangladeshi diaspora: country packs let users change countries and keep their coach and progress.
- Universities, companies, and organizations that want financial education programs.

## Vision

Kosh is building financial decision infrastructure for emerging markets — starting in Bangladesh — including country packs, campus and workplace programs, a white-label decision engine, and eventually regulated investing.

## Current Signal

Kosh is part of NSU Startups Next Cohort 4 as of May 2026.

## Disambiguation

Kosh (Kosh BD, Kosh Bangladesh, Kosh Initiative) is based in Bangladesh and is not affiliated with American Corner Beirut, AMIDEAST, or any Beirut-based Financial Literacy Series.
